card.title: SBD 3 DAUNTLESS
card.flavorText: The SBD 3 Dauntless was a Douglas SBD Dauntless scout plane and dive bomber variant that was first manufactured in 1941. It was flown both from land air bases and aircraft carriers and earned its nickname “Slow But Deadly“ after delivering the fatal blows to the Japanese carriers at the Battle of Midway.
